senses.gloss: m. = h. שַׁקָּר, liar; faithless, faithless man.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 55b:14">Yeb. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>או איהו שקראי או אנא שַׁקְרִי</he> either he is a liar, or I lied (misreporting R. Johanan).—Pl. <he>שַׁקָּרִין</he>, <he>שַׁקָּרֵי</he>, <cite ref="U01046"><he>שָׁקְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Zephaniah 3:4">Targ. Zeph. III, 4</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="U01853"><he>שָׁ׳</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 9:1">Targ. Jer. IX, 1</cite> (not <he>שִׁקְרִין</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 26:10">Targ. Is. XXVI, 10</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="U01046"><he>שַׁקְ׳</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:7">Lev. R. s. 26</cite>, v. <cite ref="U01897">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Sotah 35a:9">Sot. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>מרגלים ש׳ הוו</he> the spies were liars (drew on their imagination).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 29a:23">Snh. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>סהדי ש׳ אאוגרייהו זילי</he> false witnesses are despised by their own employers; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 222:2">Yalk. Kings 222</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 688:1">Yalk. Ps. 688</cite> <he>מרי סהדי שקרין אנן</he> my lord, we are false witnesses; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:3:5">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מרי שיקרין</he> (corr. acc.).
